tasks.gr9-renewable-non-renewable-resources-t4: Topic: Renewable and Non-Renewable Resources. Cover resource types, examples, sustainability, and depletion risks. Ask learners to classify resources, explain differences, discuss sustainability, or analyze resource challenges.
tasks.gr9-overfishing-overgrazing-t4: Topic: Overfishing and Overgrazing. Cover causes, impacts, and management of resource depletion. Ask learners to explain these problems, describe environmental impacts, propose solutions, or analyze case studies.
tasks.gr9-food-security-farming-t4: Topic: Food Security and Sustainable Farming. Cover food insecurity causes, sustainable agriculture, and solutions. Ask learners to define food security, describe sustainable practices, explain barriers, or propose interventions.
tasks.gr9-technology-sustainability-t4: Topic: Technology and Sustainable Resource Use. Cover agricultural technology, renewable energy, digital solutions, and their role in sustainability. Ask learners to identify technologies, explain benefits, discuss accessibility, or propose tech solutions.
